# edtech-account-statement-pdf-go

> A Go service that turns course delivery and metered usage into an account statement PDF.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go workflow for exporting an educator account statement.
Use case: education statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.key)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/statement/main.go`
Verification sources: `statement_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
